Question Choices: A truck carries no more than 1500 kg. Boxes weigh 20 kg and crates weigh 50 kg. Write the inequality. Let b count boxes and c count crates.
Hints: Multiply each count by its weight.
Solution: Weight per box times box count plus weight per crate times crate count gives the load. At most/no more than includes the upper limit (<=); the requested constraint is 20b+50c<=1500. Object counts are nonnegative integers.

Question Choices: A recipe needs at least 10 cups total of flour f and oats o. Write the inequality.
Solution: Add flour cups and oats cups. At least includes the lower limit (>=); the requested constraint is f+o>=10. Amounts and durations are nonnegative in this context.

Question Choices: A school buys x chairs at $30 each and y tables at $70 each for at most $1500. Write the inequality.
Hints: Write each item cost as price times quantity.
Solution: Price times quantity for each item gives the total cost. At most/no more than includes the upper limit (<=); the requested constraint is 30x+70y<=1500. Object counts are nonnegative integers.
